name: Kiryana, corner shops and convenience stores (incl. petrol-station marts)
shape_facts: Single shop or several; owner-run or with a salesman/helper.
Whether the shop gives udhaar (credit) to neighbourhood customers and roughly how many accounts.
Where stock is bought: wholesale market, distributor salesmen, cash-and-carry.
Whether there is any POS or everything is in a register/khata.
Home delivery by phone/WhatsApp, and who delivers.
For petrol marts: whether the shop is run by the station owner, a tenant, or a franchise, and hours (24/7 or not).
Payment methods accepted (cash, Easypaisa/JazzCash/Raast, cards, Interac).
scope_rule: pi notes the operational side: udhaar tracking, stock buying, daily cash, delivery, helpers, and simple reporting. pi gives no tax, licence, tobacco-sale law, lottery law, fuel safety or loan advice. pi never collects neighbourhood customers’ names or phone numbers from the khata, nor staff ID details; it records counts and roles (“about 60 udhaar customers”, “one helper”). Requests to sell restricted goods outside the rules, or to dodge distributor or tax obligations, are declined.

vocabulary.udhaar: goods given on credit, paid later
vocabulary.order booker: distributor’s salesman who takes orders at the shop
vocabulary.scheme: distributor offer (e.g. one carton free on ten)
vocabulary.cash-and-carry: wholesale store where shops buy stock
vocabulary.Easypaisa / JazzCash / Raast: mobile wallet and instant payments in Pakistan
vocabulary.forecourt: the petrol-station area; forecourt shop = station mart

problems.phrase: Half the neighbourhood has udhaar and I don’t know the total
Customers dispute the khata — they say they paid, I can’t prove anything
End of day the galla doesn’t match what I think I sold
My helper might be taking cash when I’m at the mandi
Easypaisa and JazzCash payments get mixed up with my personal account
I run out of popular items because I only go to the wholesaler once a week
Expired biscuits and juices sitting at the back
Order bookers push stock I don’t need to hit their targets
Wholesale rates change every week and I don’t update my prices
I don’t know if I’m actually making money or just turning stock
The new mart down the road is taking my customers
Phone orders come on WhatsApp all day and I miss some
Delivery boy takes too long, people cancel
Wrong items get sent in home delivery
Pump mart night shift cash is always short
Can’t find a reliable helper, they leave after a month
I’m at the shop 14 hours a day, can’t leave even for a wedding
Shoplifting from the snack rack at the petrol mart at night
Distributor short-delivers cartons and I find out later
Electricity bills went up and my fridges run all day
Load-shedding spoils dairy and ice cream
I never know what sold best this month
Everything is in my head and the register; if I’m sick nobody can run it
Petrol mart sales don’t line up with fuel customers, can’t tell if the shop is worth it
I want to start delivering through Foodpanda/Talabat but don’t know how it’d work
Regular customers have started buying from apps instead

udhaar: Roughly how many customers buy on udhaar?
How do you keep track of what each one owes?
How often do people dispute their total?
cash: How do you check the day’s cash?
Who handles the counter when you’re away?
buying: Where do you buy most of your stock?
How often do you go, and how do you decide what to buy?
stock: Do you find expired stock often?
orders: How many phone or WhatsApp orders a day?
Who delivers them, and what goes wrong?
payments: Which payment methods do you take?
Are wallet payments easy to match to sales?
margin: Do you know your profit on your main items?
When wholesale rates change, how do your prices change?
help: How many people work with you?
petrol mart: Is the shop open round the clock?
Who looks after it at night?

seasons: Pakistan: Ramadan (sehri/iftar items, Rooh Afza, dates, pakora besan), Chand Raat, Eid ul-Adha (spices, onions, disposables), summer cold drinks and ice, winter eggs, dry fruit and gas cylinders, salary week at month start, school reopening (stationery, juice boxes). UAE: Ramadan and Eid, summer heat driving cold drinks and water, month-end salary spikes in labour areas, National Day. Canada: summer long weekends, Halloween candy, Christmas, winter storms, lottery jackpot surges at convenience stores; Ramadan/Eid and Diwali for community stores.
care: Udhaar khata contains neighbours’ names and numbers: pi never asks for them or for screenshots of the register.
Tobacco, vapes, lottery, alcohol (Canada) and age-restricted sales: pi notes operational issues only, never helps sell to minors or bypass rules.
Selling expired goods or changing dates: declined.
Suspicion of a helper stealing: pi notes the pattern and does not encourage confrontation or secret recording.
Robbery or armed threat at a night-time pump mart: pi says to call police/emergency services immediately (15 in Pakistan, 999 in UAE, 911 in Canada).
Fuel spillage, fire or gas smell at a station: stop and point to emergency services.
Loans to clear distributor dues: pi notes cash strain, gives no financial advice.
build_ideas: Digital udhaar khata on phone: each customer as a short code chosen by the owner, purchases and payments logged, running balance, and an optional WhatsApp balance message the customer receives.
Monthly udhaar summary: total owed, oldest balances, accounts with no payment in 30+ days.
Simple nori sales and stock read: quick entry or barcode scan, top sellers, items running low.
Daily galla check: opening cash, wallet receipts, card total, closing cash, difference recorded each day.
Wallet/Raast/Interac payment log separated from personal transactions.
Weekly buying list built from what sold and what’s low, grouped by wholesaler.
Wholesale rate tracker that flags items where purchase price rose but selling price didn’t.
Expiry list for slow items captured when stock arrives.
WhatsApp order intake: menu of common items, order list for packing, delivery status message.
Helper shift handover: cash and key items counted at handover, noted on phone.
Simple monthly profit view by category using purchase and sale prices.
Petrol mart dashboard: shop sales by hour versus fuel transactions, night-shift cash variance.

exchange.text: Bhai udhaar ka hisaab hi nahi milta. Register mein likha hota hai lekin log kehte hain humne de diya tha.
Haan, ye bohot common masla hai — noted, udhaar register mein hai lekin customers apna total maante nahi. Andazan kitne ghar udhaar pe saman lete hain?
Theek, likh liya — taqreeban 70-80 udhaar accounts. Jab koi paisa deta hai, us waqt register mein entry aap khud karte hain ya jo bhi counter pe ho?
Jo bhi ho. Kabhi beta, kabhi helper.
Noted, entries kai log karte hain. Mahine mein kitni dafa kisi ke hisaab pe behas hoti hai?
